title.narrative: Securing the Yemeni Ministry of Water and Environment's needs for equipment and devices to contain the fuel and fertilizer leak resulting from the sinking of the ship Rubimar.

description.narrative: 1. Develop national capacity to deploy a stockpile of oil spill and hazardous and harmful substance release response equipment, along with associated personal protective equipment. • Procure specialized oil spill response equipment to protect and clean up environmentally sensitive areas. • Provide a stockpile of personal protective equipment for incident responders. • Procure a remotely operated underwater vehicle (ROV) capable of diving to a depth of 200 m. • Develop an equipment maintenance program. 2. Provide an experienced international and local consultant to provide ongoing in-country technical support for one year. • Enable regular inspections of the Robimar hull. • Provide in-country technical support. • Develop a practical training program.
2. Enhancing human security to prevent pollution of marine food sources. 3. Enabling marine environmental protection. 4. Rebuilding national capacity.
Developing national capacity by providing the necessary equipment to contain fuel and fertilizer spills in the Red Sea.
